title: Campaign Asset Archive Gap
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:ops asset_type=* archive_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(archive_state!="archived",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by asset_type
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending campaign assets backlog by asset type for campaign record-keeping.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside campaign record-keeping.
implementation: Mark each `rpg:ops` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `asset_type`.
visualization: Table of asset type with pending campaign assets counts.
grandmaExplanation: It builds where unfinished campaign assets are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in campaign record-keeping.
